known_limitations: Semantic conformance is established for the declared Reference Implementation applicability contour.
Domain-specific rules without universal applicability are explicitly applicability-gated and are not inferred.
Operational/infrastructure conformance remains a separate dimension from semantic conformance.
epistemic_boundary: Release metadata and conformance status do not establish truth of any Record, Claim, Evidence, inference, decision, action, or result.
source_commit: resolved by CI at release-gate execution
